name: model-to-native
note: captured from a real run: mapPoint is round(x / from.width * (to.width - 1)) clamped to [0, to.width - 1], not a scale by toScreen.width. The far corner of the model screenshot gives round(719 / 720 * 1079) = round(1077.5014) = 1078 and round(1543 / 1544 * 2315) = round(2313.5006) = 2314; scaling by 1080/720 and 2316/1544 would have produced 1079 — the last pixel — which is exactly what the (axis - 1) target avoids. First pass guessed 1079 and the run corrected it.
